headline: This law renames a Postal Service building in Laredo, Texas, after three service members.
what_it_does: The law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2395 East Del Mar Boulevard in Laredo, Texas, the Lance Corporal David Lee Espinoza, Lance Corporal Juan Rodrigo Rodriguez and Sergeant Roberto Arizola Jr. Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 7, 2024.
